claims: Dan Levy's new show is a Netflix crime-comedy series titled "Big Mistakes".
The premise of "Big Mistakes" is that two deeply incapable siblings played by Dan Levy and Taylor Ortega are blackmailed into the world of organized crime in New Jersey.
Dan Levy is the showrunner of "Big Mistakes".
"Big Mistakes" is Dan Levy's first major television project since Schitt's Creek.
"Big Mistakes" is part of Dan Levy's overall deal with Netflix.
Laurie Metcalf plays the siblings' mother in "Big Mistakes".
Taylor Ortega is in the cast of "Big Mistakes".
Abby Quinn is in the cast of "Big Mistakes".
Jack Innanen is in the cast of "Big Mistakes".
Critics have described "Big Mistakes" as a "caustic" and "chaotic" comedy.
The first season of "Big Mistakes" consists of eight episodes.
All episodes of the first season of "Big Mistakes" were released at once on Netflix.
"Big Mistakes" is currently streaming on Netflix.
